subject: Request to shift Thursday demo — align with VP travel window
messages:
From: Daniel Price <daniel.price@broadline.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to shift Thursday demo — VP travel conflict

Hi Hannah,

Quick note — Sofia (our VP Product) just got a last-minute itinerary change and her flight lands late on Thursday night. She wants to be on the demo (key decision driver for us) and asked if we could push the session that we currently have at 1:00pm PT on Thu to either earlier that day or to Friday morning.

We value the Redwood deep-dive; Sofia specifically asked to join for the architecture and rollout section. Is there any flexibility on your side? If it's easier, we can also do a condensed 45-min window Friday at 10am PT.

I've attached our updated agenda and MAP for reference.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Price
Director, Solutions
Broadline Retail

Attachment: proposed-agenda-v2.pdf (pdf), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Price <daniel.price@broadline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift Thursday demo — VP travel conflict

Thanks for the heads-up, Daniel — totally understand.

Quick answers:
- We can move the full demo window to Friday 10:00am PT; Marissa (solutions engineer) can tighten the architecture walkthrough to 40–45 minutes to keep it focused for Sofia.
- If you prefer Thursday earlier, we have a 10:00am PT slot but it would mean a shorter Q&A.

Marissa, Karthik — can you confirm availability for both windows (Thu 10:00am PT or Fri 10:00am PT)? If Friday works, I'll update the calendar and send a revised agenda link.

Daniel — I've copied the calendar link below for quick acceptance once we pick a slot. Also flagging the MAP items we think are most relevant to Sofia (security, multi-tenant routing, and SLA options).

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=demo-20250806-1300
Docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/agenda-BL-1372

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Both windows work for me. If Sofia is able to join for a slightly longer slot Friday, I can bring in a brief live demo of the Dedicated routing fallback and show a quick trace in the Console — that appears on her checklist. If we do Thu 10am, I'll compress the demo to 35–40 minutes and push the deeper trace to follow-up.

Karthik, do you want to be on whichever slot Sofia picks for the architecture Q&A?

Marissa

All good from my side — Friday 10am PT is preferable (less risk of Sofia getting delayed), and I can shift my prep to include a 10-minute architecture deep-dive focused on rollout + on-prem considerations.

If Broadline confirms Friday, Hannah — can you also send a brief note to ops@broadline.com to reattach the new calendar invite and include dial-in details for Sofia's remote joining? I'll prep the architecture slide 2 updates and post them to the agenda doc.

Daniel / Sofia —
Per team availability we'd like to propose moving the session to Friday 10:00am PT to ensure full sponsor coverage. New invite will come from my calendar; please accept when you see it.

Proposed condensed agenda (45–60 min):
- 0–10m: introductions + decision goals (Hannah / Daniel)
- 10–30m: architecture & rollout (Karthik)
- 30–45m: Console demo: routing, tracing, and SLA examples (Marissa)
- 45–60m: Pricing/next steps + MAP (Hannah)

Let me know if you need a dedicated technical breakout after the session.

Thanks,
Hannah
